scope: Actual execution differences from initial benchmark plan. No source output is rewritten and no biological interpretation is supported.

channel_crystallographic_waters.initial_derivation: Eight nearby crystallographic water heavy atoms included in derived channel input.
channel_crystallographic_waters.actual_preparation: remove_waters=true removed all eight original water heavy atoms. Subsequent solvation supplies new TIP3P waters. The three selected potassium ions were retained.
channel_crystallographic_waters.claim_limit: Do not claim crystallographic or coordinating-water retention through preparation. This is a solvent-only software test, without a membrane or validated channel hydration/occupancy model.

minimization_caps.initial_plan_text: A generic max1000iterations was written for all cases.
minimization_caps.actual: Existing GROMACS minimization uses steepest descent max2000 steps; OpenMM uses max1000 iterations. The 5000-step setting is the separate 10-ps relaxation trajectory, not minimization.
minimization_caps.source_of_actual_steps: data/integration-checks/five-system-gromacs/1SUG-native-checks.json minimize_log performance line, independently read. Worker minimization definition and actual minimize.mdp both specify2000.
minimization_caps.claim_limit: Engine stopping criteria differ. Reaching native minimizer tolerance does not establish ensemble equilibration or MD convergence.

authorization: Autonomous bounded software tests remain within the approved two-hour/five-GB case limits; these details are disclosed rather than used to cancel valid running tests.
